clue.text: Two thirds of these things have a barrier due to a circus act

parts.note: the things this circus performer puts down the throat, pointed to by the definition
a wall is a barrier
money due is owing

explanation.surface: A puzzling remark that most of some circus props are fenced off because of the act they belong to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'These things' leans on the definition: they are the blades the act involves. 'Two thirds of' tells you that the barrier and the debt make up the last ten of the fifteen letters: SWORDS + WALL + OWING.
explanation.definitionFit: Sword-swallowing is a classic sideshow and big-top performance in which blades are passed down the gullet.

clue.text: Figure of speech or grammar, forty winks an hour?

parts.note: forty winks is a nap, here with its article: a nap
hora is the Latin word for an hour

explanation.surface: A playful question about whether a short sleep every hour counts as a rhetorical device.
explanation.walkthrough: A NAP + HORA, the Latin hour. Anaphora is both the rhetorical repetition of an opening word and, in grammar, a word such as a pronoun referring back to an earlier one.
explanation.definitionFit: Anaphora names a rhetorical device of repeated openings and also a grammatical back-reference, covering both senses offered.

clue.text: Sack to do with 13

explanation.walkthrough: 13 across is SHOT, and you fire a shot. The same word means to dismiss someone from employment.
explanation.definitionFit: To dismiss an employee is to fire them, and discharging a gun's bullet is likewise firing it.

clue.text: The way the theatre gets honoured came from Iolanthe

explanation.walkthrough: Iolanthe is a Gilbert and Sullivan operetta; its hero, the half-fairy shepherd, is called Strephon.
explanation.definitionFit: Strephon is the Arcadian shepherd at the centre of Gilbert and Sullivan's comic opera, so he originates in that work.

clue.text: Celestial turn of phrase

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful second sense: someone calling for drinks all round wants them for everyone present.
explanation.definitionFit: An all-round player is versatile, and drinks 'all round' are bought for every member of the company.

taken as written
